answer: Postal code check: each ID must enter a 12-digit code mailed on paper to a unique street address, re-sent every 90 days. Addresses are normalized and salted-hashed, so one address equals one ID; a whisper of reuse (two IDs on one hash) freezes both for 4 epochs. Rewards climb from 10% to their zenith of 100% over 6 cycles, so fakes earn little early. Renting 100 mail drops costs about $1,500 per year, and the ledger stays marble-hard: the address hash is append-only.
